🎥🎬: The Drama (2026)

Emma and Charlie are a seemingly perfect couple preparing for their wedding when a drunken game with friends takes an unexpected turn. Emma reveals a shocking secret from her teenage years—that she once planned a school shooting but never carried it out. The confession completely changes how Charlie sees the woman he is about to marry. 

As the wedding approaches, Charlie struggles with fear, doubt, and whether he can truly accept Emma’s past. Their relationship begins to unravel under the weight of secrets, guilt, and outside judgment, forcing both of them to decide whether their love can survive knowing the darkest parts of each other.

source_details.title: The Drama
source_details.synopsis: The Drama is a 2026 American romantic dark comedy film written and directed by Kristoffer Borgli. It stars Zendaya and Robert Pattinson as a happily engaged couple whose relationship is tested by an unexpected revelation the week before their wedding. The Drama premiered on March 17, 2026, in Los Angeles and was released in the United States by A24 on April 3. The film received generally positive reviews from critics and grossed $134.9 million worldwide on a $28 million budget becoming a box office success.
